TMC Trial Coordinator Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC Trial Coordinator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Trial Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Trial Coordinator post at Tata Memorial Centre is scheduled for 13th August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Trial Coordinator position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Science (M. Pharm, Life Sciences, Biotech, Zoology, Botany, etc.) with a PG Diploma in Clinical Research, or a Graduate degree in Science with a PG Diploma in Clinical Research.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Trial Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Trial Coordinator post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Trial Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Trial Coordinator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Trial Coordinator post will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Tata Memorial Centre, HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, 842004.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. Is experience required for the Trial Coordinator position?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, one year of experience in a relevant field is considered desirable for the Trial Coordinator position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Trial Coordinator at Tata Memorial Centre is on a contract basis.
